captions_note: the reel's captions stay on and sit over the lower part of the card. Look at one snapshot inside the slot: if the caption band lands on the face in the card or on the card's icons, hide the reel captions for the slot (--hide-captions a-b) or set ICONS = False
in_a_reel: set F_IN to 23 or later (the shrink takes 21 frames, so frame 0 is the plain picture) and F_OUT at least 45 frames after it and 2 frames before the slot ends. F_OUT = None only when the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
leave GRADE = '' (the reel owns the look; a grade here would also sit on the plain frames at both ends)
NAME is the buyer's own handle or stays ''. Never a count, a made-up handle or someone else's name on the card
steps: run onsets.py      # 1. word onsets as frames -> F_IN, F_OUT (and FOLLOW_AT ...)
edit the CLIP block in build.py

run prep.py      # 2. measure + bake (about 1 min). LOOK at work/check.jpg:. cyan card under the head, green box on the head, pink = what comes out. Wrong? change HEAD_OUT / CARD / HEAD,. try with prep.py and the argument "measure" (5 s), then run prep.py once more without it
run build.py SAFE=1      # 3. page with the safe guide
hf snapshot --at 0.0,1.5,2.0,3.0,4.0      # use your own times
run build.py      # 4. clean page (no guide), then render
run check.py      # 5. plain frames at both ends vs the a-roll + work/final_sheet.jpg
